_comment: The provenance ledger for every third-party review published on this site. Same job media-sources.json does for footage and photographs: nothing quoted on a page exists without a row here, and a removal goes through this file rather than through the HTML. Not read by build.py. Reviews render as visible HTML in the section files listed under `placed`; they NEVER go into schema.json, per the standing note in corporate/schema.json _reviews_note (first-party Review markup on your own LocalBusiness is the self-serving pattern Google's review-snippet guidelines reject).
_attribution_rule: Name, month and year, then the source in plain text: 'From the Thumbtack profile of Jordan Lovinger, guitar.' No link, ever. Thumbtack is a paid lead marketplace that lists our competitors on the same page, and Jordan's profile FAQ publishes hourly rates, which collides with the no-published-prices law.
_verification_rule: Only reviews carrying Thumbtack's 'Hired on Thumbtack' badge may be published. Five of the twenty-six do not carry it and are all held below.

thumbtack-jordan-lovinger.aggregate: 5.0 across 27 reviews, which is 26 distinct: Florence S. (2024-10-18) is listed twice with identical text.
thumbtack-jordan-lovinger._whose: These reviews were left for Jordan Lovinger's own business, not for Signet. He plays guitar on this roster, and the quotes name him, which is what makes publishing them honest. The attribution line says whose profile they came from.

published.author: Mara S.
published.why: States the page's central claim in a buyer's words: played quietly enough that guests could keep talking.
published.edit: Verbatim, in full. Her typo 'tru pro' is hers and stays.

published.author: Lindy R.
published.event: Corporate event, 101 to 150 guests, four hours, outdoors
published.why: Names the NBCUniversal picnic, and the NBCUniversal mark is in the logo strip directly above it. The only review on the profile that corroborates a credit the site already claims.
published.edit: Excerpted. Opening sentence, then an ellipsis, then the two sentences on reading the crowd and adjusting volume. Dropped: the Thumbtack response time, the phone call, the amplifier and power detail, the closing line.

published.why: Names the processional she asked for, which is the learned-song policy in the note directly above it, happening.
